items.title: Are AI Data Centers Overvalued?
items.summary_ko: Investors are growing more critical of AI investments, especially data centers. But while neocloud stocks are under pressure, many believe the demand for computing resources remains strong -- and investment needs to happen now.

items.summary_ko: Kelvin Huang, Vice President of Taiwan's Delta Electronics, discusses the outlook for AI data-center demand, and says that the company expects strong growth for years to come. He speaks with Stephen Engle on Bloomberg Tech Asia.

items.title: SK Hynix Pulls Solidigm’s $10 Billion IPO on Regulatory Pushback
items.title_ko: SK Hynix Pulls Solidigm’s $10 Billion IPO on Regulatory Pushback
